workflows.description: Read client-side script for how it handles untrusted values, and server code for origin and policy checks
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Render a local, static copy of a page or script to confirm a parsing or sink question that does not need live interactivity
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.

workflows.description: Read declared headers and exercise a server-side origin check with request headers you control
prerequisites: Authorized same-origin requests through the scoped HTTP client on the confirmed origin, with the method, headers, cookies and body the approved scope declares.
